origin: docs/CWE-434/javascript Common Pitfalls: Detecting content type but still writing under a static-served directory

finding.name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
finding.summary: an uploaded image is stored inside a statically served directory

trap: Pointing at the signature check as the fix. Content-type detection is already present and passing; the destination is still inside the express.static root, so an accepted SVG is fetched and rendered from the origin.
must_preserve: A successful upload still responds with JSON carrying a url the client can fetch, and an unsupported type still returns 400 with the same error shape.
